clips.source: AAOS normal range of motion (Greene & Heckman 1994)
clips.label: Range-of-motion demonstration from AAOS normal limits (educational simulation, not measured motion); pelvis, legs and feet only; the skeleton above the pelvis, muscles and ligaments do not move

movements.name: hip adduction
movements.note: AAOS 30; right side 25: femur meets the right hip bone 4.0 mm deep at 30 degrees but 1.0 mm at 25 (left side clear at 30). Cause not determined (donor anatomy or right hip-centre error)

movements.name: hip external rotation
movements.note: AAOS 45; right side 40: femur meets the right hip bone 2.9 mm deep at 45 degrees but 0.4 mm at 40 (left side 0.8 at 45). Cause not determined

movements.name: ankle dorsiflexion
movements.note: AAOS 20; right side 15: fibula meets the right talus 2.2 mm deep at 20 degrees but 0.9 mm at 15 (left side clear at 20). Cause not determined
